308:Agents are stateful, multi-turn conversations built on top of prompts and tools. `defineAgent` bundles a system prompt, tools, and (optionally) a session store into a single ergonomic chat API. 364-The [`@genkit-ai/middleware`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@genkit-ai/middleware) package provides ready-made middleware to add common functionality to your AI requests:
365-
366-- **`retry`** - Automatically retry failed requests with exponential backoff.
367-- **`fallback`** - Fall back to alternative models on specific error statuses.
368-- **`toolApproval`** - Restrict tool execution to an approved list, interrupting unapproved calls for review.
369-- **`filesystem`** - Give the model sandboxed read/write access to a directory on the filesystem.
370-- **`skills`** - Scan for skill definitions and inject them as available tools.
371:- **`agents`** - Delegate to sub-agents by exposing each as a dedicated delegation tool.
372-- **`artifacts`** - Give the model tools to read, create, and update session artifacts.
